quick_skim.title: WildDepth-v2: A Synchronized RGB--LiDAR--Radar Dataset and Benchmark for Metric Depth, Motion, and Tracking of Wildlife
quick_skim.abstract: Measuring animal distance and motion in metric units underpins abundance estimation, morphometrics, and movement ecology, yet monocular video lacks metric scale and wildlife datasets lack metric ground truth. We present WildDepth 2, extending the synchronized RGB-LiDAR WildDepth dataset in three directions. (i) Imaging radar: 37 RGB-LiDAR-4D-radar sequences (19,716 frames) with per-point Doppler velocity and a measured error budget, to our knowledge the first imaging-radar wildlife recordings. (ii) Benchmarking: a frozen, checksummed hidden test set for RGB-only distance estimation and RGB+sparse-LiDAR depth completion, evaluated separately on animal and background pixels. (iii) Motion and tracking: metric 3D trajectories obtained by lifting 2D tracks using LiDAR, radar, or monocular depth. Across 48,723 animal frames, object-level radar calibration improves monocular depth over scene-level LiDAR calibration without requiring LiDAR at inference (AbsRel 0.120 vs. 0.198), although animal-level LiDAR remains more accurate (0.052). Across 431 tracks, once-per-track radar scaling reduces 3D position error four-fold (2.20 to 0.58 m) and distance-sampling detection-function bias from -13% to -2%, matching once-per-track LiDAR calibration. Transferring radar Doppler onto LiDAR produces motion masks 3.7 times denser than radar alone at 72% precision, reduces moving-animal LiDAR accumulation error by 37%, and estimates radial speed (r = 0.60), albeit with approximately 50% underestimation.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该工作针对单目视频缺乏度量尺度、野生动物数据缺乏度量真值的问题，构建可评估度量深度的数据集与基准。方法上将同步RGB-LiDAR数据扩展为含4D成像雷达的37段序列，并设置冻结的隐藏测试集，分别评估纯RGB距离估计与RGB加稀疏LiDAR的深度补全。实验在动物与背景像素上分开评测，并加入运动与跟踪任务。其价值在于为单目度量深度估计提供带真值的真实场景基准，可直接支撑深度模型评测。

quick_skim.title: Learning and Reasoning with Geometry: How Generation Helps Spatial Understanding
quick_skim.abstract: Image and video generators can produce spatially consistent visual content, but how to use this capability to improve spatial understanding remains underexplored. We study this problem from two perspectives: geometric supervision during training and explicit geometric evidence during inference. To this end, we introduce a unified geometric understanding and generation model (GeoUG) that integrates depth and multi-view generation with spatial understanding. First, we design a multi-scale depth codec that enables metric-depth generation using a pretrained visual autoencoder, and show that joint training yields task-dependent gains in spatial understanding. Second, we introduce 3DCueBench to control geometric difficulty while balancing selected 2D cues, and find that generated depth provides larger reasoning gains on questions requiring fine-grained geometric discrimination. Building on this finding, we develop adaptive interleaved reasoning, in which GeoUG first drafts an answer and then decides whether to generate geometric evidence to confirm or revise it. We train this decision through reinforcement learning, balancing accuracy gains over retaining the draft against generation cost. GeoUG achieves circular accuracies of 97.9%, 90.8%, and 94.2% on CV-Bench-3D, 3DCueBench, and DA-2K with fewer generation calls than always generating.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: multi-scale depth codec enabling metric depth generation within a unified geometry model

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: GeoUG studies how generative models help spatial understanding, introducing a multi-scale depth codec that enables metric-depth generation with a pretrained visual autoencoder and jointly training depth, multi-view generation and spatial understanding.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 图像与视频生成模型能产出空间一致的视觉内容，但如何借此提升空间理解仍缺乏探索。作者提出统一几何理解与生成模型GeoUG，设计多尺度深度编解码器，使预训练视觉自编码器能够生成度量深度，并将深度生成、多视角生成与空间理解联合训练。实验显示联合训练在空间理解任务上带来依赖任务的增益，并构建了可控几何难度的评测基准，为生成式几何监督提供了新思路。

quick_skim.title: MixSIS: Mixed-supervised instance segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Weakly-supervised instance segmentation (WSIS) based on either box-, point-, or image-level annotations has been proposed to overcome the labor-intensive annotation process in fully-supervised instance segmentation. Despite decent results, most WSIS methods only focus on a single annotation level, ignoring that some objects are easy to spot from point annotations, while others require box or even mask annotations. Therefore, we propose the Mixed-Supervised Instance Segmentation (MixSIS) task, which allows a flexible mix of annotation levels (image, point, box, and mask) within a dataset. MixSIS has a high practical relevance, as it allows optimizing the annotation process by annotating challenging objects in more detail, while saving time on simpler instances with less detailed annotations. To address MixSIS, we propose AnnotationsMixer (AnnsMixer) as a baseline. AnnsMixer is a truly mixed-supervised instance segmentation system, which generates pseudo mask annotations from all annotation levels, even mixed within a single image. We evaluate AnnsMixer on both WSIS and MixSIS tasks, largely outperforming state-of-the-art methods. In three case studies, we also demonstrate how the unique features of MixSIS and AnnsMixer can substantially reduce the annotation time (-90%) or improve the results (+34%) in instance segmentation with a simple annotation rule or leveraging heterogeneous data. Our code is available at https://github.com/chwilms/MixSIS
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: mixed-supervised instance segmentation with flexible annotation levels

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: MixSIS introduces a mixed-supervised instance segmentation task that lets a dataset freely combine image, point, box and mask annotations, so that easy objects are labeled cheaply and hard ones in detail, reducing annotation cost.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 现有弱监督实例分割方法通常只依赖单一标注层级，忽略了不同目标的可标注难度差异。本文提出混合监督实例分割任务MixSIS，允许在同一数据集中灵活混用图像级、点、框与掩码标注，从而对难例精细标注、对简单实例节省成本。该设定具有较高实用价值，为实例分割的数据标注流程优化提供了新的任务形式与配套方法。
